scorer: diagnostic normal-feature cosine 1NN; not AMNAR, AEM, or ZeProM
within_task: bank from available normal task training videos; calibrate only 3 official normal validation videos
leave_one_task_out: bank from the four source tasks only; calibrate their 12 normal validation videos; no target task training or calibration input
frame_calibration: empirical heuristic under dependent pooled frames; no finite-sample exchangeability claim
block_calibration: max score in a fixed non-overlapping 1-second block; blocks in same video remain dependent
video_calibration: one maximum per normal validation video; conformal guarantee conditional on exchangeable normal calibration/test videos and frozen scorer
video_CRC: mean fraction of 1-second blocks alerting per normal video; bounded monotone loss; guarantee conditional on exchangeable videos, not arbitrary new-task shift
tail_handling: incomplete final block excluded from block metrics
ECE: not computed: normal-distance scores are not error probabilities and normal-only calibration cannot identify both-class correctness probabilities
status: first local diagnostic; published-detector and VLM experiments remain separate
